offers_products.reason: Main offering is payment processing and settlement via one API; the platform is delivered as a service, not a sold product.

offers_services.reason: Licensed payment processing, local payment methods, cross-border settlement and payouts for merchants; also subscription bundling distribution.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Merchants choose and buy Boku; consumers only pay through it at checkout of digital brands.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to digital merchants such as streaming, media and advertising brands, and partners like telcos, banks and wallets.

recurring_revenue.reason: Earns on ongoing transaction volumes and recurring subscription payments processed for the same merchants under continuing contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Revenue tracks subscription and digital spending processed; merchants don't easily cut payment acceptance, though volumes may soften.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent payment transactions and subscription charges processed continuously for merchants.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its payments platform, licences and telco/wallet network, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are leading global digital brands, large streaming, media and advertising companies, plus telco partners.

asset_heavy.reason: Cloud-based platform on AWS with licences and integrations; no plants, fleets or property needed to grow.
